text: Now this is the kind of science that gets me excited. Researchers have figured out how to use sunlight to turn plastic waste into hydrogen fuel - killing two birds with one stone.

speaker: alice
text: Brilliant! Clean up the environment while creating clean energy. And here's another breakthrough - scientists have developed a new CRISPR technique that can turn genes back on without cutting DNA.

speaker: charlie
text: That's like having a dimmer switch instead of just an on-off button for our genetic code. The possibilities for treating genetic diseases are absolutely mind-blowing.
